description: List chat conversations with actors in a workspace, most recently active first, optionally filtered to one actor. Excludes the workspace assistant's conversations. Pass an id to get_conversation to read the messages.

actor_id.description: Actor (persona) UUID, from list_actors, to list only conversations with that actor. Omit to list conversations with every actor.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_conversations

id.description: Conversation UUID, the conversation_id get_conversation takes.

title: List conversations
